titles.title: Two Jimson Weeds with Green Leaves and Blue Sky

description: Two white jimsonweed flowers with yellow centers occupy the work's lower right and upper left corners. Dark green leaves with bright, yellowish-green veins frame the blooms. A softly shaded blue background fills the composition's negative space.
title: Two Jimson Weeds with Green Leaves and Blue Sky
